summary: Defines an additional Cryptographic Message Syntax content type, authenticated-enveloped-data, for use with authenticated encryption modes. It supports the same key management techniques as the existing enveloped-data type. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: This is a locked box that also has a tamper seal. It keeps the contents secret and lets the receiver know nobody changed them on the way.
